blocks.text: If you think you know his story, think again. This December, the holidays begin with a humbug when Ebenezer, directed by Ti West (X trilogy) and starring Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, opens only in cinemas. The holiday film, which also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen, will be available in cinemas nationwide starting December 2.
